Rules

  • Everything sits on the page, nothing floats. Elevation is a hard ink offset (3/6/10px, blur 0). Never use blur, alpha or ambient shadow to suggest height.
  • Ink is the outline, the text and the shadow. --color-ink #043629 does all three jobs. That single reuse is what makes bright lime/pink/purple feel calm.
  • Dark tiles get light text, light tiles get ink text. primary-foreground is ink, not white — even on saturated lime. Only paper-on-ink reverses.
  • Type is display for statements, body for instructions. Fredoka at 700 for every heading and button label; Space Grotesk for prose, captions and metadata.
  • Uppercase + 0.1em tracking marks a label. Any uppercase micro text in this system is a label, eyebrow or stamp. Never set body copy uppercase.
  • Interaction is physical. hover lifts 2px and gains shadow; active translates by exactly the shadow offset so the element presses flush. 150ms, ease-out.
  • Tilt is decoration with a ceiling. -1deg for feedback, -2deg for stickers, -6 to 12deg for callouts. Never tilt a paragraph, a control's label, or anything you must read for more than a second.
  • Round generously. Radius starts where other systems stop: buttons 36px, cards 48px, pills full. There is no small-radius UI element in the reference.
  • Motion loops are background theatre. wiggle/wobble/float/notif-pop/shape-burst run on decorative, aria-hidden elements at 0.9–12s. Content never animates on its own.
  • ✗ Use white text on lime/pink/yellow
    ✓ ink on saturated fills (matches --primary-foreground)
  • ✗ Use border-1 on cards and buttons
    ✓ 3px ink borders; 1px is for dividers and quiet chips only
  • ✗ Add soft/blurred shadows
    ✓ hard 0-blur offsets, or none
  • ✗ Use rounded-sm/md on interactive surfaces
    ✓ 2xl for controls, 3xl for cards, full for pills
  • ✗ Animate color/size on hover
    ✓ transform + box-shadow only
  • ✗ Set body copy in Fredoka
    ✓ Fredoka for headings and labels ≤2 lines
  • ✗ Introduce a new hue
    ✓ reuse the 8 brand hues + ink/paper; charts use chart-1..5
  • ✗ Use the stage/dusk surfaces for forms
    ✓ they are showcase surfaces; forms live on paper or surface
